title: High energy density solid state symmetric supercapacitors using ionic liquid dispersed Li+ ion-perovskites
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2704-2716
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07417C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bhargab Sharma, Shrishti Sharma, Gurpreet Kaur, Hardeep, Anshuman Dalvi
The study reports solid-state ceramic supercapacitors (SSCs) assembled using a novel composite electrolyte based on Li+ ion conducting perovskite-type LLTO (Li0.34La0.51TiO3) and an ionic liquid (EMIM BF4).
